feature_name: Storage Transfer Service S3-compatible source transfer to Cloud Storage (Preview)
summary: Storage Transfer Service introduced preview support for transferring data from S3-compatible storage (including AWS S3) to Cloud Storage, including transfer routing controls to reduce egress charges.
extended_definition: Storage Transfer Service introduced preview support for transferring data from S3-compatible storage (including AWS S3) to Cloud Storage, including transfer routing controls to reduce egress charges.
